office: the Immigration Services Department, applied for online and enrolled in person; abroad, Tanzania's missions
note: The electronic passport (since January 2018) costs Sh150,000 at home, as The Citizen reported from the Immigration Department (2019); the Department's fee page is a script application that renders empty for this client. Abroad the missions charge USD 90 (the High Commission in New Delhi: an application fee of USD 15, then USD 75; the Embassy in Washington: $90), a fee in dollars, the abroad route's currency. Validity and processing times are leads.

sources.title: The Citizen (Tanzania), Clock ticks for 950,000 holders of old generation passports in Tanzania (29 July 2019)
sources.said: The electronic passport costs Sh150,000, three times the old one, which was pegged at Sh50,000.

sources.title: High Commission of the United Republic of Tanzania, New Delhi, Announcement: application for new Tanzanian e-passports
sources.said: A new passport costs USD 90 payable in two stages as explained hereunder. ... you will be required to pay an application fee of 15 USD. ... to allow you to make another payment of 75 USD.

sources.title: Embassy of the United Republic of Tanzania, Washington, Passes and Passports
sources.said: Passport Fee is $90 paid online while filling application
